submittedParameters.prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve.
Image 1 is the EDIT TARGET: the newly drawn W sprite. Paint ONE new cast/W/03 frame. Images 2/3/4 are the authoritative portrait, W idle camera and approved painted game-art style. Preserve Image 1's exact head and face pixel size, proportions, full-canvas placement, pure screen-LEFT side view. Never mirror an E image. Do not zoom or fit bounding boxes.
Anatomy: exactly two shoulders, two arms, two sleeve openings and two hands. Camera-near anatomical LEFT hand grips bronze bell with red tassel. Far anatomical RIGHT hand grips fan of EXACTLY FIVE separate red rectangular talisman cards, their five rectangular top edges clearly countable. Continuous sleeve-wrist-hand connection, no third sleeve. Do not swap props.
THIS FRAME POSE: Anticipation continues: far RIGHT elbow bent tighter with exactly FIVE-card fan rising to the lower chin, hand palm gripping the common fan base. Near LEFT forearm raises the bell slightly to chest level, wrist just below shoulder. Both shoulders remain visible and connected to ONLY two sleeves. The character bends both knees softly and shifts weight to the rear foot (screen-right), head lowered naturally about 1% from target, front foot remains at screen-left, separate from rear. Torso side view with a tiny twist, serious closed mouth, gaze left. This is a small step of gathering, not the released outstretched pose.
Preserve the chestnut high ponytail, jewel crown, flame-pattern red/gold short robe, black trousers, yin-yang waist ornament, red/black/gold shoes, youthful face and rounded clean richly painted Taoist chibi style. The body can naturally rise/fall a little while bending knees; the head and all props keep identical pixel dimensions. Ground virtual y920 and root x512 at1024. No automatic per-frame resizing. Keep both hands and feet separated and readable.
Single native square frame at least1024x1024 with genuine transparent RGBA, no scenery, shadows, light effects, detached flames, particles, text or labels. No contact sheet, only this single pose.
